blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In minoritized (low-resource) language technologies, a common response to data sparsity is to aggregate text across multiple varieties and treat the combined data as a single corpus. However, mixed corpora of closely related indigenous variants can produce an artificial register that is accountable to no single speaker community, a structural failure we call variant fragmentation. This issue is acute for minoritized languages native to Mexico, such as Nawatl. Building on a 70,000-pair multi-variant foundation, we specialize an mT5-large checkpoint to Masewalkopa (nhn), the Nawatl variety spoken in Santa Ana Tlacotenco. We curate 2,665 parallel pairs, reserve all sentence-level data for evaluation, and incorporate 192 elder-transcribed target sentences via asymmetric backtranslation. A custom finite-state analyzer reduces unanalyzed surface forms from 82.0% to 19.9% and supplies functional syntax tags as plain-text prefixes, allowing the model to reuse existing subword embeddings rather than relying on frozen special tokens. The resulting LoRA-v9c-b model achieves 58.46 dev chrF++ and 58.20/57.90 directional test chrF++. Finally, CTranslate2 int8 quantization reduces CPU latency from 137.5 to 1.8-2.6 seconds per request, enabling cost-bounded Cloud Run deployment.
blocks.zh: 在次要(低资源)语言技术中,对数据相接性的一个常见反应是将多个品种的文本相接而成,并将合并后的数据作为一个单体处理. 然而,由密切相关的土著变体组成的混合体可以产生一个人工登记册,这个登记册不对单一的说者社区负责,我们称之为变体分化的结构故障。 这个问题对于墨西哥本土的次要语言,如纳瓦特尔语来说是尖锐的. 在7万帕的多变量基础上,我们专门建立了一个MT5的大型检查站,前往马塞瓦科帕(nhn),即圣安娜特拉科滕科所说的纳瓦特尔品种. 我们管理2,665个平行对子,保留所有句子级别数据以供评价,并通过不对称回译法纳入192个长者-三角形目标句. 一种自定义的有限状态分析器将未分析的表面形式从82.0%减少到19.9%,并作为平正文字前缀提供功能语法标记,使模型可以再用已存在的子词嵌入来,而不是依赖被冻结的特殊符号. 由此产生的LORA-v9c-b型实现58.46 dev chrF++和58.20/57.90方向测试chrF++. 最后,CTranslate2 int8的量子化将CPU的空档从每个请求的137.5秒降低到1.8-2.6秒,从而能够有成本限制的Cloud Run部署.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction and Linguistic Background
blocks.zh: 1 导言和语言背景

blocks.en: Nawatl is a group of endangered, closely-related, morphologically rich languages 1 1 1 I use “language,” “variant,” and “variety” interchangeably, but avoid the use of the term “dialect.” In Mexico, this distinction carries real social, educational, and political consequences, as historically the term “dialect” has been used as a tool to marginalize indigenous language speakers [ 1 ] . In government documentation, schooling, and public discourse, referring to these languages as “dialects” can contribute to marginalization and under-resourcing [ 21 ] . in the Nawan branch of the Uto-Aztecan family, spoken primarily in Mexico. There are 30 formally recognized variants of Nawatl [ 12 ] , which can have substantial phonological, morphological, syntactic, and lexical differences [ 9 ] . There is also significant variant-internal diversity. Treating them as a single computational language obscures the systems that index place and community belonging.
blocks.zh: Nawatl是一个濒危、关系密切、形态丰富的语言群体,我使用“语言”、“变种”和“变种”交替使用,但避免使用“分辨”一词。 在墨西哥,这种区分具有真正的社会、教育和政治后果,因为历史上“对话”一词被用作使土著语言使用者边缘化的工具[1]。 在政府文件、学校教育和公共言论中,将这些语言称为“语言”可造成乌托-阿兹特坎家庭纳旺分会的边缘化和资源不足[21]。 纳瓦特尔有30个被正式承认的变体[12],它们可以具有实质性的相声学,形态学,合成学,和名词差异[9]. 内部差异也很大。 把它们当作一种单一的计算语言来对待,模糊了指数排列和属于社区的系统.

blocks.en: Masewalkopa is the endonym used by speakers of the Nawatl in Santa Ana de Tlacotenco, Milpa Alta, Mexico City ( nhn ). It is morphologically rich and predominantly head marking: words can encode subject, object, derivation, aspect, possession, predicate-nominal structure, and honorific morphology. Character-level similarity can therefore conceal a wrong possessor or a form from another writing tradition.
blocks.zh: Masewalkopa是墨西哥城Milpa Alta的Santa Ana de Tlacotenco(nhn.)纳瓦特尔语使用者使用的同名词。 它在形态学上丰富而以头为主:词可以编码主题,对象,衍生,方面,占有,上位-名分结构,和荣誉形态. 因此,字符级的相似性可以掩盖错误的拥有者或一种形式与另一个写作传统相去甚远.

blocks.en: During the first author’s three years of studying Masewalkopa, he encountered persistent discrepancies between locally taught forms and Classical Nawatl-centered digital resources. As a result, his objective shifted from maximizing a generic “Nawatl” score to producing forms that can be inspected by a single, identifiable community.
blocks.zh: 第一提交人在学习Masewalkopa的三年时间里,在当地教授的表格和以Nawatl为主的古典数字资源之间一直存在着差异。 因此,他的目标从最大限度地提高一般的“纳瓦特尔”分数转向制作可由单一、可识别社区检查的表格。

blocks.en: 1.1 From a Multi-Variant Model to Single-Variant Specialization
blocks.zh: 1.1 从多变量模型到单变量专门化

blocks.en: In the first author’s previous work [ 19 ] , he assembled approximately 70,000 Spanish-Nawatl pairs across varieties and domains. The resulting system (found on huggingface 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/luisarmando/mt5-large-es-nah ) checkpoint achieved 54.15 chrF++ on a split from that same mixed collection.
blocks.zh: 在第一位作者的前作[19]中,他汇集了大约70,000对跨品种和域的西班牙-纳瓦特尔人。 由此形成的制度(从拥抱面2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/luisarmando/mt5-group-es-nah.)从同一混合收藏品中分出54.15个chrF++。

blocks.en: However, when evaluated zero-shot on an external benchmark, the AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task on Open Machine Translation for Indigenous Languages [ 17 ] , performance collapsed to 25.7 chrF++. This external evaluation dataset consisted of independent Spanish-Nawatl text that was completely unseen during training. Beyond simple domain mismatch, manual inspection revealed that the model generated conflicting lexical, orthographic, and inflectional forms from different regions within the same sentence. While each piece might be attested somewhere in Mexico, the combined output was incoherent as Masewalkopa.
blocks.zh: 然而,当在外部基准上评价了"美洲NLP 2021"关于土著语言开放机器翻译的共享任务[17],性能崩溃为25.7 chrF++. 这一外部评价数据集由独立的西班牙-纳瓦特尔文本组成,在培训期间是完全看不见的。 除了简单的域不匹配外,人工检查还发现该模型从同一个句子内的不同区域产生了相冲突的词典,正字法和词典形式. 虽然在墨西哥的某个地方可以证明每个作品,但作为Masewalkopa,其综合产出不一致。

blocks.en: We use variant fragmentation for this interaction between data aggregation and model behavior. The multi-variant corpus expresses a single underlying meaning through divergent regional realizations, the subword model shares pieces regardless of regional provenance, and beam search can assemble a fluent-looking sequence from conflicting varietal conventions. Aggregate evaluation conceals the problem when references come from the same mixture. A high in-domain score can therefore coexist with low external validity.
blocks.zh: 我们使用变异分化来进行数据聚合和模型行为之间的相互作用。 多变体通过不同的区域实现表达出单一的基本含义,子词模型不分区域出处共享片段,光束搜索可以从相冲突的变体公约中组装出一个流畅的外观序列. 当来自同一混合物的参考文献时,综合评价掩盖了这一问题。 因此,高内域分数可以与低外域有效性并存.

blocks.en: To resolve this, we warm-start from the first author’s 1.2-billion-parameter multi-variant mT5-large thesis checkpoint and adapt it exclusively with Masewalkopa data. The broad-base model provides sequence modeling and cross-lingual alignment, while the small community corpus provides regional constraints. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) makes this transfer feasible on a single GPU via compact, low-rank updates [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们从第一位作者的12亿参数的多变量mT5大论文检查点开始,并完全根据Masewalkopa的数据进行调整。 广基模型提供序列模型和跨语言相接,而小群体则提供区域制约. Low-Rank Adaptation(LORA)使得这种通过紧凑,低级更新在单一GPU上实现的转移[11].

blocks.en: In this paper, we develop a single-variety approach to neural machine translation (NMT) for Masewalkopa, using a relatively small community dataset to specialize an existing multi-variety model. By combining parameter-efficient LoRA fine-tuning with rule-based finite-state morphology and authentic target-side oral narratives, we show that targeted specialization resolves variant fragmentation while respecting the linguistic autonomy of Santa Ana Tlacotenco speech.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们为Masewalkopa开发了一种神经机能翻译(NMT)的单变量方法,使用一个相对小的社区数据集专门使用现有的多变量模型. 通过将参数效率高的LORA微调与基于规则的有限状态形态和真实的目标侧口述相结合,我们显示有针对性的专业化解决了变异分化,同时尊重了圣安娜·特拉科滕科演讲的语言自主性.

blocks.en: 1.2 Core Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.2 核心捐款

blocks.en: This paper makes four contributions: 1. Single-Variant Specialization Pipeline: We specialize a 1.2-billion-parameter NMT model with 2,665 Masewalkopa pairs, restricting short dictionary entries to training so that development and test benchmarks evaluate only full sentence translation. 2. Morphosyntactic NMT Conditioning: We expand a finite-state analyzer beyond 6,500 lexicon lines to derive surface-validated functional syntax prefixes, supplying the neural translation encoder with structural grounding to resolve morphological and lexical ambiguities. 3. Ablation Suite and Post-Mortems: We ablate asymmetric backtranslation, cold special tokens, sparse versus dense syntax, and syntax stripping in the final lora_v9c experiment. 4. Decolonial and Production Evaluation: We combine chrF++, linguistic diagnostics, DBS, human comparison, and measured CPU deployment behavior.
blocks.zh: 本文件提出了四点意见: 1. 单一变量专业 管道 : 我们专门设计了12亿参数的NMT模型,有2 665个Masewalkopa配对,将短词典条目限制在培训中,以便开发和测试基准只评价完整的句子翻译。 2. 口服NMT 条件 : 我们扩展了超过6500个词典线的有限态分析器,以得到表面验证的功能语法前缀,为神经翻译编码器提供结构地基来解决形态学和词典上的模糊. 3. 婚后套房: 我们在最后的lora_v9c实验中将非对称回译,寒冷的特殊符号,稀有对稠密的语法和语法分解. 4. 非殖民化和生产评价: 我们结合了chrF++,语言诊断,DBS,人类比较,并测量了CPU的部署行为.

blocks.en: Single-Variant Specialization Pipeline: We specialize a 1.2-billion-parameter NMT model with 2,665 Masewalkopa pairs, restricting short dictionary entries to training so that development and test benchmarks evaluate only full sentence translation.
blocks.zh: 单变量专业 管道 : 我们专门设计了12亿参数的NMT模型,有2 665个Masewalkopa配对,将短词典条目限制在培训中,以便开发和测试基准只评价完整的句子翻译。

blocks.en: Morphosyntactic NMT Conditioning: We expand a finite-state analyzer beyond 6,500 lexicon lines to derive surface-validated functional syntax prefixes, supplying the neural translation encoder with structural grounding to resolve morphological and lexical ambiguities.
blocks.zh: 毒性 NMT 条件 : 我们扩展了超过6500个词典线的有限态分析器,以得到表面验证的功能语法前缀,为神经翻译编码器提供结构地基来解决形态学和词典上的模糊.

blocks.en: Ablation Suite and Post-Mortems: We ablate asymmetric backtranslation, cold special tokens, sparse versus dense syntax, and syntax stripping in the final lora_v9c experiment.
blocks.zh: 婚后套房: 我们在最后的lora_v9c实验中将非对称回译,寒冷的特殊符号,稀有对稠密的语法和语法分解.

blocks.en: Decolonial and Production Evaluation: We combine chrF++, linguistic diagnostics, DBS, human comparison, and measured CPU deployment behavior.
blocks.zh: 脱殖民和生产评价: 我们结合了chrF++,语言诊断,DBS,人类比较,并测量了CPU的部署行为.

blocks.en: Together, these experiments demonstrate that targeted single-variant specialization overcomes the pitfalls of multi-variant data aggregation. The final specialized model ( lora_v9c_b ) achieves 58.46 dev chrF++ and 58.20/57.90 directional test chrF++, gaining over 28 points over the mixed-variant base. Ablation results show that plain-text syntactic prefixes successfully recover from the severe optimization stalls of frozen special tokens, while dense morphological tagging yields measurable structural gains (+1.33 test chrF++). Culturally, decolonial DBS probes and human A/B ratings confirm a strong reduction in colonial Spanish substitutions and improved naturalness on elder-transcribed oral narratives. Finally, 8-bit quantization and widened beam search reduce inference latency to under 2.6 seconds on standard CPU hardware, demonstrating that single-variant models can be operated within strict community budget constraints.
blocks.zh: 这些实验表明,有针对性的单变量专业化克服了多变量数据汇总的陷阱. 最终的专业型号(lora_v9c_b)实现58.46 dev chrF++和58.20/57.90方向测试chrF++,在混合变种基得到超过28分. 通缩结果显示,平正文字合成前缀从被冷冻的特殊符符的严重优化摊位中成功恢复,而密集的形态标记则产生可测量的结构收益(+1.33测试chrF++). 在文化上,去殖民的DBS探测器和人类A/B的收视率证实,殖民时期的西班牙取而代之的现象已大为减少,对长者口述的自然性也得到提高. 最后,8位分量化和拓宽光束搜索将标准CPU硬件的推论纬度降低到2.6秒以下,表明单变量模型可以在严格的社区预算限制下运行.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior machine translation research on Indigenous languages of the Americas has largely focused on pooling heterogeneous regional variants into aggregate training sets to combat extreme data scarcity [ 7 ] . However, computational dialectology and variety classification for Nawatl demonstrates that regional variants exhibit sharp lexical and morphophonological boundaries [ 18 ] . Blending these divergent systems into monolithic training corpora frequently produces varietal bleed and privileges colonial or standardized varieties over living community speech [ 3 ] . Recent work therefore emphasizes community-grounded single-variant modeling. This study builds on that foundation by specializing a broad multi-variant base directly to the spoken variety of Santa Ana Tlacotenco.
blocks.zh: 以往对美洲土著语言的机器翻译研究主要侧重于将各种区域变体汇集到综合培训中,以消除极端数据稀缺现象[7]。 然而,纳瓦特尔的计算方言学和品种分类表明,区域变体呈现出尖锐的词法和形态学边界[18]. 把这些不同的系统组合成单一的训练 公司经常产生多变的出血和特权 殖民或标准化的品种 而不是活社区语言[3]。 因此,最近的工作强调以社区为基础的单一变量模型。 这项研究在此基础上更进一步,将广泛的多变量基础直接用于圣安娜·特拉科滕科的口语品种。

blocks.en: Guiding sequence generation with explicit linguistic structure stems from factored translation architectures [ 25 ] and prefix-based syntactic conditioning [ 28 ] . For polysynthetic languages, finite-state transducers (FSTs) supply robust morphological segmentation and grammatical disambiguation where purely statistical subword models fail [ 2 ] . My system builds on these insights, demonstrating that high-density FST syntactic prefixes provide reliable structural inductive bias without requiring vocabulary modifications.
blocks.zh: 有明确语言结构的引导序列生成出自因子翻译架构[25]和以前缀为主的合成调制[28]. 对于多合成语言,有限态转录器(FSTs)在纯统计子词模型失败的地方提供强势的形态分解和语法分解[2]. 我的系统以这些见解为基础,表明高密度的FST合成前缀提供了可靠的结构诱导偏差而不需要修改词汇.

blocks.en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) [ 11 ] provides an efficient mechanism for adapting massive multilingual models such as mT5 [ 27 ] while preventing catastrophic forgetting. Extending low-rank updates across all linear projections is essential for deep domain transfer [ 6 , 10 ] . We contribute an empirical analysis of embedding constraints under LoRA, showing how plain-text subword formatting avoids the optimization collapse associated with frozen cold-token representations.
blocks.zh: 低朗克适应(Lora)[11]提供了一个有效的机制来适应mT5等大规模多语种模型,同时防止灾难性的遗忘. 在所有线性预测中扩大低级更新对于深域转移[6,10]至关重要. 我们提供了对LORA下嵌入限制的经验性分析,显示平文本子字格式化如何避免了与冷冻冷冻表达相关的优化崩溃.

blocks.en: 3 Data Curation, Corpus Composition, and Governance
blocks.zh: 3 数据校正、公司构成和治理

blocks.en:
We compiled the primary parallel corpus over nearly four years of studying Masewalkopa through community classes and structured coursework with native-speaker language instructors from Santa Ana Tlacotenco. All pedagogical exercises, classroom dialogues, and vocabulary transcriptions were recorded, digitized, and curated with the explicit informed consent of the instructors for research and educational work.
Following the Collective Benefit, Authority to COntrol, Responsibility, and Ethics (CARE) principles, we treat provenance, authority, responsibility, and ethics as pipeline properties [ 4 ] . Data collection was guided by collective benefit and mutual accountability rather than extractive aggregation.
blocks.zh:
近四年来,我们通过社区课程和结构化课程,与圣安娜特拉科滕科的母语语言教员一起,编纂了初级平行教程。 所有教学练习、课堂对话和词汇记录都进行了记录、数字化,并得到了研究和教育工作的教员的明确知情同意。
按照集体福利、共同责任、责任和道德原则,我们将来源、权威、责任和道德视为管道属性[4]。 数据收集遵循的是集体利益和相互问责,而不是采掘汇总。

blocks.en: 3.1 Cleaning and Provenance
blocks.zh: 3.1 清洁和检验

blocks.en: In machine translation, the main training unit is an aligned parallel pair consisting of a source text segment and its equivalent target translation. We compiled the primary corpus over nearly four years of studying Masewalkopa through classes and coursework with native-speaker instructors from Santa Ana Tlacotenco. All pedagogical exercises, classroom dialogues, and vocabulary notes were recorded and curated into structured spreadsheets with explicit instructor consent.
blocks.zh: 在机器翻译中,主要训练单位是一对对对齐并列,由源文本段及其等同的目标翻译组成. 我们在近四年的时间里通过与Santa Ana Tlacotenco本地语教师的课和课程工作,编纂了研究Masewalkopa的初级教材。 所有教学练习、课堂对话和词汇说明都记录下来,并整理成结构化的电子表格,并获得教员的明确同意。

blocks.en: We normalized whitespace and Unicode representations, removed empty fields, and deduplicated aligned Spanish–Nawatl segment pairs case-insensitively. Near-neighbor spellings were retained because they often encode authentic local phonological choices. Cleaning reduced 2,761 raw rows to 2,665 unique parallel segment pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们规范了白空间和Unicode的表示,删除了空字段,并忽略了对齐的西班牙语-纳瓦特尔段对大小写。 近邻的拼音之所以被保留,是因为其常被编码为真实的本地相声选择. 清洁将2,761个生行减少为2,665个独特的平行段对.

blocks.en: Each parallel pair was tagged by sentential status based on word count from standard whitespace splitting after punctuation stripping. Entries with at most two whitespace-delimited tokens were treated as lexical or short-phrase material (such as citation nouns or isolated verb stems); longer examples and independently verified clauses were treated as sentence-level. This reproducible threshold does not claim that every two-token sequence lacks syntax. Instead, it prevents dictionary correspondences from dominating evaluation splits.
blocks.zh: 每对平行对被基于平分后标准白相间分取的单词计数的提示状态所标记. 含有最多两个白空受限符的条目被作为词汇或短句材料处理(如引用名词或孤立动词出自);较长的例子和独立核实的条款被作为句子级处理. 这种可再生的阈值并不声称每个双键序列缺乏语法. 取而代之的是,它防止了字典通信主导评价分裂.

blocks.en: Table 1: Composition of the cleaned parallel corpus before bidirectional expansion, with representative examples.
blocks.zh: 表1:在双向扩张之前清理的平行体的构成,并举出有代表性的例子。

blocks.en: Nearly 45% of the pairs are lexical or very short. They teach stems and spelling but underrepresent agreement, possession, negation, and discourse. Random splitting would therefore reward dictionary matches without demonstrating sentence translation.
blocks.zh: 近45%的对子有词性或很短. 他们教授原始语和拼写语,但缺乏共识、占有、否定和言论。 因此,随机拆分将奖励字典匹配,而不显示句子翻译。

blocks.en: 3.2 Stratification and Bidirectional Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.2 分级和双向任务

blocks.en: Development and test data were drawn exclusively from the 1,477 sentence-level pairs to ensure that evaluation benchmarks measure genuine sequence translation rather than isolated vocabulary lookup. Including single-word or short lexical pairs in held-out sets would artificially inflate n-gram and character overlap scores through simple dictionary matching, masking failures in clause-level syntax, agreement, and possession. Restricting evaluation to sentential items guarantees that metrics reflect grammatical compositionality, while placing all 1,188 lexical pairs into the training inventory provides necessary stem coverage and orthographic grounding.
blocks.zh: 开发和测试数据完全取自1 477个句子级对数,以确保评价基准衡量真实序列翻译,而不是孤立的词汇检索。 将单词或短词配对纳入被搁置的组合将人为地增加正克和字符相重叠的分数,通过简单的字典匹配,掩盖条款级语法的失败,协议,以及占有. 将评价限制在示意性物品上,可以保证衡量标准反映语法构成性,同时将所有1,188个词组纳入培训清单,从而提供必要的干线覆盖和正地测量。

blocks.en: Using a fixed stratification seed, we reserved 120 sentence pairs for development and 150 for the final held-out test set. The remaining training inventory contained 2,335 pairs after recombining the lexical entries with eligible training sentences.
blocks.zh: 使用固定分层种子,我们预留了120个句子对用于开发,150个用于最后的搁置测试套. 其余的培训清单包含2 335对在重新组合符合资格的培训句子的词汇条目后。

blocks.en: The 2,335 training pairs therefore yielded 4,670 directional training examples, while the 120 development pairs and 150 test pairs yielded 240 and 300 directional evaluation examples, respectively.

blocks.en: Directional prefixes are ordinary text already present in the mT5 SentencePiece vocabulary. This detail is crucial because standard text prefixes remain trainable through attention and LoRA weight updates even when the base model’s shared embedding table is completely frozen. Joint bidirectional training doubles the available supervised training instances without requiring synthetic target generation.
blocks.zh: 方向前缀是mT5句式Piece词汇中已经存在的普通文本. 这一细节至关重要,因为标准文本前缀仍然可以通过注意来训练,而LORA的重量更新即使在基站模型的共享嵌入表被完全冻结时也是如此. 联合双向培训将现有的监督培训增加一倍,而不需要合成目标生成。

Because only the Spanish source input x ^ es \hat{x}_{\text{es}} is synthetic, the Masewalkopa generation decoder learns exclusively from authentic, elder-authored targets. We deliberately did not swap source and target to create es → nah \text{es}\rightarrow\text{nah} training examples, which would have forced the Spanish generation decoder to imitate its earlier output.

blocks.en: Deduplication preceded splitting; dev and test pairs were excluded from augmentation. We report chrF++ for its tolerance of inflectional variation [ 22 ] , but add linguistic diagnostics because overlap cannot judge regional appropriateness, possession, or honorific licensing.

blocks.en: 4 Finite-State Morphosyntactic Engineering
blocks.zh: 4 有限国家 工程学

blocks.en: While neural sequence-to-sequence models excel at cross-lingual transfer, subword tokenizers frequently fracture polysynthetic words into arbitrary pieces that obscure grammatical relations. In Masewalkopa, a single verbal form can encode subject person, object person, reflexive marking, tense, and direction. With only 2,665 curated training pairs, a purely data-driven neural encoder struggles to generalize across sparse morphological paradigms.
blocks.zh: 虽然神经序列到序列模型在跨语言转录上表现优异,但子词代词经常会将多合成词分解为任意的片段来模糊语法关系. 在Masewalkopa语中,单一的口语形式可以编码主题人物,对象人物,反射标记,紧张,方向. 由于只有2,665个被曲解的训练对子,一个纯粹由数据驱动的神经编码器在跨越稀有形态学范式的通俗化上挣扎.

blocks.en: To provide the neural translation model with explicit structural grounding, we developed a rule-based finite-state transducer using the Helsinki Finite-State Transducer (HFST) toolkit [ 16 ] . Rather than replacing the neural model, this analyzer acts as a linguistic feature extractor. It parses surface tokens into interlinear glossed text (IGT) and functional syntax labels, which are then passed directly to the NMT encoder as plain-text prefixes during training and inference (Subsection 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 为了给神经翻译模型提供明确的结构地基,我们开发了一种基于规则的有限状态转录器,使用赫尔辛基Finite-State转录器(HFST)工具包[16]. 这个分析器不是取代神经模型,而是起到语言特征提取器的作用. 它将表面符号分解为线性光泽文字(IGT)和功能语法标签,然后在培训和推论期间直接被传递给NMT编码器作为纯文本前缀(分节5.4.

blocks.en: The analyzer combines final-state morphotactic continuation lexicons with two-level phonological alternation rules [ 2 ] to capture the core grammatical inventory of Santa Ana Tlacotenco speech.
blocks.zh: 分析器结合了最终态的形态续作词典和两级相声交替规则[2],以捕捉圣安娜·特拉科滕科演说的核心语法编目.

blocks.en: 4.1 Stem Classes and Morphotactics
blocks.zh: 4.1 蒸馏类和多发性能

blocks.en: An undifferentiated lexicon overgenerates because stems select different suffixal paths. We therefore use the continuation classes in Table 2 as implementation abstractions.
blocks.zh: 一种无差别的词典过度生成,因为源出选择了不同的后缀路径. 因此,我们使用表2中的继续类作为执行抽象。

blocks.en: Table 2: Principal finite-state stem classes and the contrasts they encode.
blocks.zh: 表2:主要有限状态干分级及其编码对比.

blocks.en: Dedicated nominal paths prevent absolutive suffixes from attaching to every nominal-looking base. An audit removed sesek (cold) and tomawak (plump) from noun continuations that generated unattested -tl , -li , -tli , -in , or -itl forms.
blocks.zh: 专注的标点路径阻止了演化后缀附着在每一个标点外观基. 一项审计将Sesek(冷)和tomawak(平滑)从名词续作中移除,这些名词产生未经测试的-tl,-li,-tli,-in,或-itl形式.

blocks.en: Predicate nominals require a separate path: ti-sowatl , “you are a woman,” carries person without an overt copula. Retaining this analysis supports translation to Spanish ser constructions.
blocks.zh: 标点名词需要一条单独的路:ti-sowatl,“你是一个女人”,载人而不用露天相干。 保留这一分析支持将西班牙语 ser 构建翻译.

blocks.en: 4.2 Progressive Aspect Allomorphy
blocks.zh: 4.2 累向全向

blocks.en: Progressive arcs for -tok and -tika are licensed by stem continuation class, with TWOLC constraining boundary realizations. This generalizes beyond a flat word list, provided the allomorphs are freely attachable.
blocks.zh: -tok和-tika的渐进弧通过干续级获得许可证,其中TwoLC限制边界实现。 这种概括超越了平坦的单词列表,只要所对应的可自由附加.

blocks.en: The analysis identifies heads inside long words and exposes aspect as a stable feature. It supplements rather than replaces neural subword representations.
blocks.zh: 分析确定了长词中的头,并暴露出一面是稳定的特征. 它补充而不是取代神经子词表达.

blocks.zh: 4.3 覆盖范围扩大和错误核算

blocks.en: Repeated audits grew LEXC beyond 6,500 lines. After each justified stem addition, we recompiled and measured no analysis, permissive passthrough, and genuine segmentation. Passthrough is not counted as successful analysis.

blocks.en: 4.4 Three-Stage Reconstruction Filter
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 三阶段重建过滤器

blocks.en: Because finite-state transducers can generate multiple competing analyses or derivations for a single surface token, we use a three-stage reconstruction filter to disambiguate raw transducer outputs before assigning IGT:
blocks.zh: 由于有限度状态的导出器可以产生多个相竞分析或导出单个地表信号,所以我们使用三相重建滤波器,在分配IGT前分解原始导出器输出:

blocks.en: 1. Surface match. Retain only candidates whose reconstructed stem or diagnostic realization aligns to an ordered substring of the normalized token. 2. Possessive guard. Require overt initial no- , mo- , to- , or i- for a possessive analysis. This blocks bare nouns and coincidental stem-initial strings from receiving NP.POSS . 3. Category preference. Prefer the open-class analysis covering most surface material, except when a listed adverb matches the entire token. Preserve genuine ties for sentence-level resolution.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning a 1.2-billion-parameter model on a small dataset requires balancing parameter adaptation against rapid memorization. In lora_v1 , we evaluated a short 3-epoch schedule on real pairs. In lora_v2 , we extended training to 8 epochs with evaluation every 200 steps. Extending the schedule raised dev chrF++ from 40.26 to 46.18 (+5.92 points). Validation performance peaked at epoch 6 before plateauing by epoch 8, demonstrating that low-rank adapters need sufficient steps to align cross-lingual representations but quickly overfit if trained past convergence.

blocks.en: Standard backtranslation risks degrading the generation decoder by training on hallucinated synthetic targets. To prevent this, we implemented an asymmetric protocol: using the nah → es \text{nah}\rightarrow\text{es} capability of lora_v2 , we generated synthetic Spanish source prompts for 192 continuous narrative utterances spoken by community elders, adding these pairs strictly to the es → nah \text{es}\rightarrow\text{nah} training split ( train_bt.jsonl ). Integrating these 192 backtranslated pairs in lora_v3b increased dev chrF++ from 46.18 to 49.40 (+3.22 points) and raised both directional tests to approximately 49 chrF++. Although representing only an 8% increase over the real-pair inventory, they introduced multi-clause discourse patterns and authentic elder-authored syntax that isolated pedagogical pairs lack.
blocks.zh: 通过对幻觉合成目标的训练,标准回译有降低生成解码器的危险性. 为了防止这种情况,我们实施了一个不对称的协议:我们利用 rah → es\text{nah}\rightarrow\text{es} lora_v2 的能力,为社区长者所讲的192个连续叙事词制作了合成西班牙语源提示,将这些对子严格地添加到 ers_ nah\text{es}\rightarrow\text{nah} 训练分拆(火车_bt.jsonl) 中。 在lora_v3b中将这192个回译对加成后将dev chrF++从46.18个加成到49.40个分(+3.22分),将两个方向测试提升到约49个chrF+. 虽然与真实的pair目录相比只增加了8%,但他们引入了多语种的语法模式和真正的长者语法,这些语法孤立了教学对子的缺失.

blocks.en: 5.4 Failure Analysis: Cold Embedding Degradation
blocks.zh: 5.4 失败分析:冷嵌入式退化

blocks.en: In lora_v4 and lora_v6 , we attempted to delimit syntactic conditioning regions using dedicated special tokens ( <source> , <syntax> , and <no_syntax> ). This intervention resized the shared vocabulary from 250,100 to 250,103, introducing uninitialized rows into the embedding matrix. Because standard LoRA freezes the base embedding table to conserve GPU memory, these newly added token vectors received zero gradient updates and remained fixed random vectors throughout training.
blocks.zh: 在lora_v4和lora_v6中,我们试图使用专用特殊符号("源","语法"和"诺")来划定合成调节区域. 这一干预将共享词汇由250,100个调整为250,103个,将未初始化的行引入嵌入矩阵. 由于标准LORA冻结了基底嵌入表来保存GPU内存,这些新添加的符号向量得到了零梯度更新并在整个训练中保持了固定的随机向量.

blocks.en: Presenting the encoder with static random vectors at structurally critical positions caused total optimization failure: training loss stalled above 30.0 and dev chrF++ collapsed to 8.91. While unfreezing the full embedding table resolved the representation issue conceptually, it immediately exhausted T4 GPU memory.
blocks.zh: 在结构临界位置呈现静态随机向量的编码器导致全面优化失败:培训损失停滞于30.0以上,dev chrF++倒塌至8.91. 虽然解冻了完整的嵌入表在概念上解决了代表问题,但它立即耗尽了T4 GPU内存.

blocks.en: In lora_v5 , we resolved this constraint by passing functional syntax as ordinary text prefixes (such as nah->es: ADV HEAD NP.POSS ) segmented with the existing SentencePiece vocabulary. Reusing pretrained subword representations stabilized optimization without custom checkpoint surgery and restored dev chrF++ to 51.69. All subsequent runs retain this plain-text prefix format.
blocks.zh: 在lora_v5中,我们通过将功能语法作为普通文本前缀(如nah->es:ADV HEAD NP)来解决了这一制约. POSS)与已存在的PriestPiece词汇分出. 重用被预先训练过的子词表示器稳定了优化,没有定制检查站手术,并恢复了dev chrF++为 51.69. 之后的所有运行都保留了此纯文本前缀格式.

blocks.en: 5.5 Sparse and Dense Syntax Coverage
blocks.zh: 5.5 分词和语法

blocks.en: To assess how annotation density affects conditioning, we compared two versions of the finite-state analyzer. In lora_v7b , the early prototype produced functional syntax tags for only 29.5% of corpus sentences. Adding these sparse prefixes yielded virtually identical development scores to the unconditioned lora_v7a control (51.31 versus 51.22 chrF++) and slightly degraded directional test accuracy.
blocks.zh: 为了评估注释密度如何影响条件,我们比较了两个版本的有限状态分析器. 在lora_v7b中,早期的原型只为29.5%的官能团句制作了功能语法标记. 加上这些稀有的前缀,在无条件的lora_v7a控制(51.31对51.22 chrF++)和方向测试精度略有下降后,开发得分几乎相同.

blocks.en: Because sparse tags occurred inconsistently, the model treated them as shallow domain indicators rather than reliable syntactic grounding. In lora_v8b , once rule expansion and reconstruction filtering raised tag coverage to 95.8%, syntax conditioning produced a +1.33 chrF++ gain on complex nah → es \text{nah}\rightarrow\text{es} polysynthetic targets and a +0.51 spillover gain on es → nah \text{es}\rightarrow\text{nah} . This demonstrates that syntactic conditioning requires high annotation density to guide sequence generation effectively. Precision in the reconstruction filter remains critical, as inaccurate tags would inject systematic structural noise.
blocks.zh: 由于零星标记的出现不一致,模型将它们视为浅域指标,而不是可靠的合成地基. 在lora_v8b中,一旦规则扩展和重建过滤器将标记覆盖率提升到95.8%,语法调制在复合 nah → es\text{nah_rightarrow\text{es}多合成目标上产生了+1.33 chrF++的增益,在 es\ nah\rightarrow\text{n}上产生了+0.51的外溢增益. 这表明综合调节需要高注密度来有效引导序列生成. 重建过滤器的精度仍然至关重要,因为不准确的标记会注入系统的结构噪音。

blocks.en: 5.6 Final lora_v9c Ablation and Model Selection
blocks.zh: 5.6 最后卢拉_v9c 模拟和模型选择

blocks.en: To isolate the precise contribution of dense syntactic prefixes on the final training set, we evaluated a controlled ablation where the extracted syntax tags were stripped from input sequences during training and inference ( strip=True ), leaving only bare source text.
blocks.zh: 为了在最终的训练集中隔离密集的合成前缀的精确贡献,我们评价了一种可控的去除,在训练和推论(stre=True)期间从输入序列中剥取所提取的语法标记,只留下了光源文字.

blocks.en: On the development split, the syntax-stripped control reached 58.91 chrF++, while the syntax-conditioned model ( lora_v9c_b , strip=False ) reached 58.46 chrF++, a minor difference of − 0.45 -0.45 points.
blocks.zh: 在开发分解上,语法-stript control达到了58.91 chrF++,而语法-条件模型(lora_v9c_b,stract=False)达到了58.46 chrF++,细差为−0.45-0.45分.

blocks.en: Despite this small aggregate difference on dev, we selected the syntax-conditioned checkpoint ( lora_v9c_b ) for production deployment. The explicit syntactic prefix provides necessary structural disambiguation for complex grammatical constructions that aggregate character metrics fail to penalize. These include differentiating modifier versus predicate readings of kwalle , resolving null-copula structures, and tracking possessed nominal arguments. We report the unconditioned control’s development score transparently, but accept this minor trade-off to ensure consistent grammatical interpretability. Across fully evaluated held-out test splits, lora_v9c_b remains our strongest model, reaching 58.20 and 57.90 directional test chrF++.
blocks.zh: 尽管在dev上的总和差别很小,但我们还是选择了按语法设置的检查点(lora_v9c_b)进行生产部署. 明晰的"综合"前缀为复杂的语法构造提供了必要的结构分解,而聚合字符度量法不能惩罚. 其中包括区分修饰符和kwalle的前置读取,解决了无效的copula结构,以及跟踪拥有名义上的论点。 我们以透明的方式报告无条件控制的发展得分,但接受这种小的取舍,以确保一致的语法解释性。 通过全面评价的搁置试验分裂,lora_v9c_b仍然是我们最强的模型,达到58.20和57.90方向试验chrF++.

blocks.en: 6 Qualitative Translation and Decolonial Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6 定性翻译和非殖民评价

blocks.en: Automatic scores summarize thousands of character n-grams but do not explain which linguistic decisions changed. We therefore use diagnostic examples to examine regional spelling, word-internal person marking, possessive prefixes, predicate nominals, and honorific morphology. The examples in Table 6 are targeted probes, not an independent statistical test. They are included to make the error categories falsifiable and to show what is inspected during community-facing review.
blocks.zh: 自动分数总结了上千个字符n克,但没有解释哪些语言决定改变了. 因此,我们使用诊断性实例来检查区域拼写、文字内部标识、占有前缀、前缀和荣誉形态。 表6中的实例是有针对性的调查,而不是独立的统计测试。 列入这些表格是为了使错误类别可以伪造,并表明在社区审查期间检查了什么。

blocks.en: Table 6: Representative Spanish-to-Masewalkopa diagnostic comparisons. The base column illustrates mixed-variant or segmentation failure modes; bold material highlights the locally targeted form in the production output.
blocks.zh: 表6:具有代表性的西班牙-马塞瓦科帕诊断比较。 基柱显示混合变异或分解故障模式;粗体材料突出显示生产产出中的当地目标形式.

blocks.en: The first row probes a short lexical form to test whether the model preserves isolated citation vocabulary. The mixed model favors a broad Classical-style lexical form, while specialization produces the correct person-marked Masewalkopa string nimitstlasohkamate . The important change is not only orthographic. The production form packages the relation between speaker and addressee inside the word, rather than returning an uninflected dictionary-style equivalent.
blocks.zh: 第一行探索出一种简短的词典形式来测试模型是否保留了孤立的引用词汇. 混合模型倾向于广义的古典风格的词典形式,而专业化则产生正确的被人标注的马塞瓦科帕字符串nimittlasohkamate. 重要的改变不仅仅是正字形. 制作形式包写了单词内部的扬声器和收件人之间的关系,而不是返回一个不反映的字典式等同.

blocks.en: The second and fourth rows test possession and the honorific or reverential suffix -tsin . The base output separates to from a generic piltzin , resembling word-by-word transfer and failing to realize the locally analyzed possessed stem. lora_v2 learns the possessive prefix but omits the full honorific ending. lora_v9c_b produces to-kone-tsin , keeping first-person plural possession and the respectful/diminutive morphology in one nominal word. Such a distinction can affect interactional stance even when the untranslated content word “child” is recoverable.
blocks.zh: 第二行和第四行测试拥有和荣誉或纪念后缀 - tsin. 基础输出从一般的平津分出, 类似逐字传输, lora_v2 学习了占有性前缀,但省略了完整的荣誉结局. lora_v9c_b 生成 to-kone-tsin,将第一人称复数拥有和尊重/二分营养形态保存在一个名义上. 这种区分可能影响到互动立场,即使未翻译内容的 " 儿童 " 一词是可以恢复的。

blocks.en: The third row illustrates predicate nominals. A mixed output with separate ni can be interpreted as a tokenization artifact or as a cross-variety spelling convention. The correct tisowatl realizes person marking on the predicate. In the final phrase, kwalle must be interpreted in relation to that predicate, not assigned a fixed label solely from its dictionary gloss. This is the type of ambiguity that motivated the retention of syntax conditioning in lora_v9c_b .
blocks.zh: 第三行说明了上游名义。 混合输出与独立的ni可以被解释为象征化的文物,也可以被解释为跨变相拼写公约. 正确的tisowatl 实现人标记 在上游。 在最后一句话中,kwalle必须结合上游来解释,而不是仅仅从其词典上指定一个固定的标签。 这种模棱两可的方式促使在lora_v9c_b中保留语法条件.

blocks.en: Qualitative analysis also reveals what the current table cannot establish. A single human reference is not the only grammatical realization, and matching it exactly is not proof of social appropriateness. Honorific morphology can be licensed by participant relation and discourse context, neither of which is fully represented in isolated Spanish prompts. For deployment, the examples are therefore paired with warnings against treating the system as a normative authority.
blocks.zh: 定性分析还揭示出本表无法确定的. 单一的人类参考并非唯一的语法实现,而精确的匹配并不能证明社会适宜性. 荣誉形态学可以通过参与者关系和讨论背景获得许可,两者都没有在孤立的西班牙提示中得到充分体现. 因此,就部署而言,这些例子与不把该系统视为规范权威的警告相配合。

blocks.en: 6.1 Domesticating Bias Score
blocks.zh: 6.1 将比阿斯分数国内化

blocks.en: Standard multi-variant Nawatl corpora are heavily skewed toward colonial-era missionary texts, biblical translations, and pan-variety pedagogical materials. Models trained on these resources inherit a structural bias toward archaic, standardized Central forms (such as tlazohcamati or cihuatl ), which local speakers perceive as alien or domesticating. In contrast, translation into the community demands fidelity to the living, spoken variety of Santa Ana Tlacotenco (such as nimitstlasohkamate or sowatl ). To evaluate this dynamic directly, the Domesticating Bias Score (DBS) measures the proportion of diagnostic translations in which a model defaults to generalized, colonial-derived variants rather than verified local community lexical choices.
blocks.zh: 标准多变量 Nawatl Corpora对殖民时代的传教文书、圣经译本和泛华教教材严重偏差。 在这些资源方面受过培训的模型继承了一种结构上偏向过时的、标准化的中央形式(如tlazohcamati或cihuatl),当地发言者认为这些形式是异形或驯化的。 相反地,翻译成社区语言要求忠实于活生生的圣安娜·特拉科滕科(如nimittlasohkamate或sowatl)。 为了直接评估这一动态,国内Bias Score(DBS)衡量诊断翻译的比例,其中模型默认为通用的殖民衍生变体,而不是经核实的当地社区词汇选择。

blocks.en: Length is measured in decoder tokens. A positive DBS indicates that the model assigns a higher average per-token log-probability to the domesticated candidate, whereas a negative DBS indicates a preference for the sovereign candidate. Values near zero reflect weak preference or equally probable alternatives.
blocks.zh: 长度用解码符来测量. 一个积极的DBS表示,该模型给被驯化的候选人分配了较高的平均每个托肯日志概率,而负的DBS表示倾向于主权候选人. 接近零的数值反映了偏好弱或同样可能的选择。

blocks.en: Token normalization is necessary because sovereign formulations can be longer than borrowed Spanish nouns or simplified roots, either morphologically or periphrastically. Without normalization, summing raw log-probabilities almost always penalizes longer strings because each additional token contributes a nonpositive term. The score is contrastive rather than absolute. It does not declare any individual term intrinsically colonial. Instead, each contrastive pair must be constructed with community speakers who can evaluate the social and historical distinctions in context.
blocks.zh: 托肯正常化是必要的,因为主权配方可能比借入的西班牙名词或简化根要长,无论是形态学上还是直觉上. 没有正常化,对原始的对数概率进行总结,几乎总是惩罚较长的字符串,因为每个附加的符号都贡献一个非正值。 得分呈对比性而非绝对性. 它没有宣布任何个人术语本质上属于殖民。 相反,必须同社区演讲者建立每一对对比的对等关系,他们可以根据背景评估社会和历史的区别。

blocks.en: On the illustrative seed set used during development, mean DBS shifted from − 1.313 -1.313 for the base model to − 0.380 -0.380 after specialization. Under the sign convention in Eq. 3 , both values favor the sovereign candidate, but the specialized score is closer to zero. It would therefore be incorrect to describe this shift as a stronger sovereign preference. The result instead reflects a reduced magnitude in the modeled contrast. We retain the metric because it exposes candidate-level probability distributions, but we interpret direction and magnitude explicitly rather than attaching an uncritical label to every numerical movement.
blocks.zh: 在开发期间使用的示意图种子组上,DBS的平均值从基模的− 1.313-1.313转至专业后的−0.380-0.380. 在Eq. 3的签章大会下,两种价值观都偏向于主权候选人,但专业分数更接近于零. 因此,将这一转变描述为更强烈的主权偏好是不正确的。 结果反映了模型对比度的下降。 我们保留这一衡量标准,因为它暴露了候选人的概率分布,但我们对方向和规模的解释是明确的,而不是在每个数值运动上附加不批评的标签。

blocks.en: This distinction is methodologically important. In production evaluations, DBS can be reported alongside bootstrap confidence intervals over contrast pairs, sign tests for the proportion of instances with DBS < 0 \mathrm{DBS}<0 , and stratified subsets across specific phenomena, including lexical borrowing, kinship terminology, toponyms, and ceremonial register.
blocks.zh: 这种区分在方法上很重要。 在生产评价中,可以报告DBS与靴子置信间隔相并列,比对对,DBS < 0\mathrm{DBS}<0 > 实例比例的签名测试,以及跨越具体现象的分级子集,包括词典借贷、亲属名词、地名和礼仪登记。

blocks.en: Future community-designed evaluation benchmarks should also support a “both acceptable” label to ensure that the metric does not impose an artificial binary interpretation on ordinary dialectal variation.
blocks.zh: 由社区设计的未来评价基准还应支持一种“可接受”的标签,以确保该衡量标准不会对普通方言变化强加人为的二进制解释。

blocks.en: 6.2 Error Analysis and Qualitative Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 6.2 错误分析和定性失败模式

blocks.en: Although the production system ( lora_v9c_b ) substantially improves lexical alignment and local morphology, systematic qualitative inspection reveals several recurrent failure modes on difficult constructions. Table 7 categorizes representative translation errors observed on the held-out evaluation sets.
blocks.zh: 虽然生产系统(lora_v9c_b)大大地改进了词汇的对接和局部形态,但系统的质量检查揭示出在困难的构造上几种反复发生的故障模式. 表7对在搁置评价中观察到的代表性翻译错误进行了分类。

blocks.en: Table 7: Representative diagnostic failure modes produced by the production model ( lora_v9c_b ) against authentic community references.
blocks.zh: 表7:生产模式(lora_v9c_b)在真实的社区参考文献中产生的具有代表性的诊断故障模式。

blocks.en: These errors cluster into three distinct linguistic phenomena:
blocks.zh: 这些错误归纳为三种不同的语言现象:

blocks.en: When translating clauses that contrast knowledge with memory (such as kemma nikmate, wan ammo nikilnaamike ), the model occasionally repeats the higher-frequency cognitive root mate (‘to know / feel’) in the second coordinate clause instead of generating the intended psychological retrieval predicate ilnaamiki (‘to remember’).
blocks.zh: 当翻译与记忆相对应的条款(如kemma nikmate, wan ambum nikilnaamike)时,该模型偶尔会在第二坐标条款中重复高频认知根配体( " 要知道/感受 " ),而不是生成预期的心理回溯上位( " 要记住 " ).

blocks.en: On roots and adverbials shared across Central Nawatl varieties, the model occasionally defaults to generalized Central spellings (such as yalwa and itak ) rather than generating the localized Santa Ana Tlacotenco orthography with preconsonantal aspiration ( yalhwa and ihtak ), reflecting residual weight bias from the multi-variant base checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 在中纳瓦特尔品种共有的根和柱上,该模型偶尔会默认通用的中央拼写(如雅尔瓦和伊塔克等),而不会生成具有前共振愿望的本地化的"圣安娜·特拉科滕科正文"(雅尔瓦和伊赫塔克等),反映了多变基站的剩余重量偏差.

blocks.en: In transitive verbal complexes combining directional or person prefixes with temporal adverbs (such as mustla nimitsmachtis ‘tomorrow I will teach you’), the decoder occasionally drops the final future suffix -s , yielding an uninflected or present-tense form ( nimitsmachtia ) despite explicit future context in the source.
blocks.zh: 在将指向性或人前缀与时间副词(如: " 我明天会教你 " 的 " mustla nimitsmachtis " )相结合的过渡性口语复合体中,解码器偶尔会放下最后的未来后缀-s,产生出一种不反映或现成的形体(nimitsmachtia),尽管源头有明确的未来背景.

blocks.en: 7 Production Deployment and CPU Profiling
blocks.zh: 7 生产部署和CPU分析

blocks.en: A model that requires a research GPU for every query is difficult to sustain as a community-facing service. We therefore merged the selected lora_v9c_b adapter into the base checkpoint, converted the model to CTranslate2 [ 13 ] , and quantized weights for int8 CPU inference. Conversion fixes one deployable artifact and removes the need to load separate adapter modules at request time.
blocks.zh: 每个查询都需要研究GPU的模型很难维持为社区化服务. 因此,我们把选定的lora_v9c_b适配器合并入了基站检查站,将模型转换为CTranslate2 [13],并量化了Int8CPU推论的权重. 转换会修正一个可部署的文物,并消除根据请求时间装入单独的适配器模块的需要.

blocks.en: 7.1 Latency Profile
blocks.zh: 7.1 延迟简介

blocks.en: Native fp32 PyTorch inference on CPU required 137.5 seconds for a representative request. This latency is unsuitable for an interactive translator and increases the period for which a billed container must remain active. On a Cloud Run allocation of 2 vCPUs and 4 GiB RAM, the CTranslate2 int8 artifact produced typical sentence latencies of 1.8 to 2.6 seconds. Taking the range endpoints, the observed speedup is approximately 137.5 / 2.6 ≈ 52.9 137.5/2.6\approx 52.9 to 137.5 / 1.8 ≈ 76.4 × 137.5/1.8\approx 76.4\times .
blocks.zh: 原生fp32 PyTorch对CPU的推论需要137.5秒才能提出代表性请求. 这种延迟不适合交互式翻译,而且会延长计费集装箱必须保持活动的时间。 在2个vCPU和4个GiB RAM的"云跑"分配上,CTranslate2 int8文物产生了1.8至2.6秒的典型句子后缀. 取测距终点,所观测出的速度约为137.5 / 2.6 / 52.9 137.5/2.6 / 52.9 至 137.5 / 1.8 → 76.4 × 137.5/1.8 / 76.4 相近 .

blocks.zh: 表8:生产路径的CPU推论剖面. 延迟是观测到的请求级值,不应被解释为硬件独立的基准.

blocks.en: The comparison combines runtime optimization and quantization, so it does not isolate the causal contribution of int8 weights alone. It answers the operational question of whether the fully converted path is fast enough to serve an interactive request within the selected CPU allocation.
blocks.zh: 比较结合了运行时间优化和量化,因此它不会单独孤立出Int8重量的因果贡献. 它回答了运行问题,即完全转换的路径是否足够快,在选定的CPU分配范围内服务交互请求.

blocks.en: 7.2 Beam Search Divergence on Short Forms
blocks.zh: 7.2 短表束搜索差异

blocks.en: Initial deployment testing found mid-word truncation on short lexical inputs, including nimitstlasohkamate . The failure initially appeared to be a quantization artifact [ 8 ] , but comparisons across converted precisions showed it was precision-independent. Greedy and narrow-beam paths could terminate after a high-probability partial subword sequence even though the full form was preferred by the original evaluation setup.
blocks.zh: 初步部署测试发现在短语输入(包括nimitstlasohkamate)上出现中字截取. 失败起初似乎是被量化的文物[8],但是对转换精度的比较表明它是精度独立的. 贪婪和窄束路径可以在高概率的分词序列后终止,即使完整的形式被原评价设置所偏好.

blocks.en: Increasing beam_size from 4 to 8 eliminated the observed truncations in the short-form regression set. The wider beam retained complete hypotheses long enough for the accumulated sequence score to overtake prematurely terminated candidates. This is described as beam search divergence rather than as a general CTranslate2 defect because the trigger depends on the model’s score distribution, tokenization, length normalization, and stopping behavior [ 14 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 将光束从4个增加到8个,消除了在短式回归集中观察到的切入. 大梁保留了完整的假设,足够累积序列分数超过提前终止的候选人。 这被描述为光束搜索差异,而不是一般的CCTranslate2缺陷,因为触发器取决于模型的分数分布,标志化,长度正常化,以及停止行为[14,26].

blocks.en: The production API sets the beam size to 8 and runs regression probes after every model conversion. The probes include single words, morphologically long words, short clauses, both translation directions, and forms with possessive or honorific material. This test set is separate from the research test split. Its role is software validation, specifically ensuring that a numerically strong model does not become linguistically unusable after conversion.
blocks.zh: 制作的API将光束大小设定为8个并运行每个模型转换后的回归探测器. 探针包括单词,形态上长词,短条款,两种翻译方向,并有占有或荣誉材料的形式. 这个测试集与研究测试分拆分开. 它的作用是软件验证,具体确保一个数值强的模型不会在转换后变成语言上无法使用.

blocks.en: 7.3 Cloud Run Microservice Architecture
blocks.zh: 7.3 云跑微服务 建筑

blocks.en: The service exposes a FastAPI application within a container that includes the CTranslate2 model and the mT5 tokenizer assets. A translation request passes through four stages: 1. validate direction, input length, and Unicode text; 2. construct the direction and optional syntax prefix; 3. tokenize, decode with beam size 8, and remove model control text; 4. return the translation plus non-sensitive runtime metadata.

blocks.en: validate direction, input length, and Unicode text;
blocks.zh: 校验方向、输入长度和Unicode文本;

blocks.en: construct the direction and optional syntax prefix;
blocks.zh: 构造方向和可选语法前缀;

blocks.en: tokenize, decode with beam size 8, and remove model control text;
blocks.zh: (一) 标出、解码出8个梁大小并删除模型控制文本;

blocks.zh: 返回翻译加非敏感运行时元数据。

blocks.en: The Cloud Run revision uses 2 vCPUs, 4 GiB RAM, and a maximum of two instances. The instance cap limits both concurrency and worst-case cost. Because model loading is expensive relative to a warm translation, the container initializes the model once at process startup rather than once per request.
blocks.zh: Cloud Run修订版使用2 vCPU,4 GiB RAM,最多2个实例. 实例上限限制货币成本和最坏情况成本。 由于相较于取暖翻译,模型加载费用昂贵,容器在启动过程中一次性地初始化模型,而不是每个请求一次.

blocks.en: CORS is configured through an explicit allowlist for the web client origins that require browser access. Methods and headers are restricted to the translation interface rather than using an unrestricted wildcard in production. CORS is not authentication, so request validation, rate limiting at the surrounding platform layer, and conservative maximum input lengths remain necessary. The API does not log full translation content by default, since sentences may contain names or culturally sensitive material.
blocks.zh: CORS通过一个明确的授权列表来配置需要浏览器访问的网络客户端源. 方法和标题仅限于翻译界面,而不是在制作时使用不受限制的通配符. CORS不是认证,所以请求验证,在周边平台层限制速率,保守的最大输入长度仍然是必要的. API不默认登录完整的翻译内容,因为句子可能包含姓名或文化上敏感的材料.

blocks.en: 7.4 Automated Cost Controls
blocks.zh: 7.4 自动化费用控制

blocks.en: A billing budget publishes threshold notifications to Pub/Sub. A subscribed Cloud Function evaluates the notification and disables project billing when the configured hard threshold is reached. This is intentionally stronger than an email alert: an alert informs the operator, while the function can stop additional billable use. The mechanism complements the Cloud Run maximum-instance setting and protects a student-operated project from traffic spikes or accidental loops.
blocks.zh: 预算账单向Pub/Sub发布门槛通知。 一个订阅的 Cloud 函数对通知进行评价, 并在配置的硬阈值达到时禁用项目计费 。 这有意比电子邮件提醒更强:提醒通知操作员,而功能可以停止额外的可计费使用. 该机制补充了Cloud Run的最大限度监视设置,并保护学生操作的项目不受堵塞或意外环路的影响.

blocks.en: Disabling billing is disruptive and can stop unrelated resources in the same project. For that reason, the deployment isolates the translator within a dedicated project, tests the function at non-production thresholds, and documents manual recovery procedures. Budget automation also has notification latency, so it is a final circuit breaker rather than a substitute for instance caps, request quotas, and monitoring.
blocks.zh: 禁用计费会造成干扰,可以阻止同一项目中的无关资源. 因此,部署将笔译员隔离在一个专用项目内,在非生产阈值测试功能,以及文件人工回收程序。 预算自动化也具有通知延迟性,因此它是最后的断路器,而不是诸如上限、要求配额和监测等替代品。

blocks.en: 8 Discussion, Limitations, and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 8 讨论、限制和可复制性

blocks.en: The experiments show that a mixed-variant checkpoint can provide useful transfer when a second stage redirects it toward one documented variety. Authentic target provenance matters in backtranslation, and symbolic conditioning becomes useful only after analyzer coverage is dense and reconstruction is precise. This does not imply that speakers or models must be linguistically isolated. A future multi-variety system could explicitly condition on community, orthography, or speaker preference rather than aggregating those distinctions without labels.
blocks.zh: 试验显示,如果第二阶段将其转向一种有文件记载的品种,混合变种检查站可以提供有益的转移。 真实的目标出处在回译中很重要,而象征性的调制只有在分析器覆盖密集而重建精确之后才变得有用. 这并不意味着发言者或模型必须在语言上孤立。 未来的多变量系统可以明确地以社区、正体或演说者偏好为条件,而不是在没有标签的情况下将这些区别加以汇总。

blocks.en: The corpus remains small and pedagogically skewed. Its 192 oral-text sentences cannot represent all genres or speakers, the human evaluation has 20 items with only 2 raters, and DBS is still an illustrative probe of candidate log-probability distributions rather than an absolute metric. Likewise, reaching 72.9% genuine FST segmentation in the lexicon reflects rule coverage rather than verified parsing precision. Future work must validate analyses by morpheme type, especially possession, aspect, and predicate nominals.
blocks.zh: 教程仍然很小,在教学上有偏差。 它的192个口语句子不能代表所有流派或演说者,人评价有20个项目,只有2个评分器,而DBS仍然是对候选日志概率分布的说明性探针,而不是绝对度量. 同样,在词汇中达到72.9%的FST真正的分化反映了规则的涵盖范围,而不是经过核实的精确度。 今后的工作必须验证按morpheme类型进行的分析,特别是拥有、方面和前缀。

blocks.en: Full reproducibility requires the deduplicated split manifest, directional JSONL, FST source hash, adapter configuration, selected checkpoint, random seeds, and decoding settings. Sentence-only scores must remain separate from lexical data.
blocks.zh: 完全可复制性需要去重复的分块表,方向JSONL,FST源散列,适配器配置,所选检查点,随机种子,以及解码设置. 仅判分数必须与词汇数据分开。

blocks.en: Responsible release also requires speaker-approved access conditions for oral texts and a model card that names Masewalkopa as the target variety, documents errors, and provides routes for correction or removal.
blocks.zh: 负责任的发布还需要发言者批准口头文本的进入条件,以及一张将Masewalkopa命名为目标品种的示范卡,文件错误,并提供改正或删除的路径.

blocks.en: This is something that will be spoken about and talked with the community before making any data accessible for any other purposes.
blocks.zh: 在将任何数据用于任何其他目的之前,将同社区谈论和讨论这个问题。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 9 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: This work began with a fundamental dilemma in minoritized language technologies: while aggregating data across regional varieties combats data sparsity in the aggregate, it produces an artificial, blended register that is accountable to no single speaker community. As demonstrated by my initial 70,000-pair thesis baseline, high scores on mixed-corpus benchmarks can easily mask severe structural failure on authentic regional speech. We have termed this failure variant fragmentation .
blocks.zh: 这项工作首先在次要语言技术方面出现了一个根本的两难境地:一方面汇总各区域品种的数据,一方面在整体上消除了数据痉挛现象,另一方面却产生了一个人工的、混合的登记册,不对任何单一的讲者社区负责。 正如我最初的70,000-pair论文基线所显示的那样,在混合公司基准上的高分很容易掩盖在真实的区域言论上严重的结构故障. 我们称之为故障变体分解。

blocks.en: To resolve this issue, this paper demonstrated the process and effectiveness of specializing an existing sequence-to-sequence model to a specific regional variety: Masewalkopa ( nhn ), spoken in Santa Ana Tlacotenco. Using a relatively small community corpus of 2,665 curated pairs, a stratified evaluation split that strictly measures sentential syntax, and 192 authentic elder-transcribed narrative targets integrated through asymmetric backtranslation, we adapted a 1.2-billion-parameter checkpoint on a single GPU. The resulting specialized system ( lora_v9c_b ) achieved 58.46 dev chrF++ and 58.20/57.90 directional test chrF++, gaining over 28 points over the initial multi-variant baseline.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,本文展示了将现有序列至序列模型专门用于特定区域品种的过程和有效性: Masewalkopa (nh),在Santa Ana Tlacotenco上所讲。 使用一个相对较小的由2,665个配对而成的群团,一个分层的评分,严格地衡量了派生语法,以及192个真实的长者三角化叙事目标通过不对称回译整合,我们在一个单一的GPU上改造了一个12亿参数的检查站. 由此而来的专业系统(lora_v9c_b)实现了58.46 dev chrF++和58.20/57.90方向测试chrF++,比起最初的多变量基线获得了超过28分.

blocks.en: Beyond aggregate metric gains, my experimental ablations and failure analyses provide concrete architectural takeaways for indigenous and polysynthetic NMT: 1. Subword embedding constraints in LoRA: Introducing new special tokens while freezing the shared embedding matrix creates an untrained bottleneck that stalls model convergence. Conditioning the translation encoder using plain-text syntactic prefixes reuses the pretrained subword space and completely recovers model performance. 2. Density in morphosyntactic conditioning: Sparse functional syntax tags act merely as shallow domain indicators, whereas high-coverage tags (95.8%) generated by a rule-based finite-state analyzer provide explicit structural guidance that improves translation on complex polysynthetic targets (+1.33 chrF++). 3. Decolonial and multi-faceted evaluation: Character overlap metrics alone cannot detect whether a translation respects local autonomy. Combining diagnostic morphological probes, length-normalized Domesticating Bias Scores (DBS), and blind human ratings verified that the specialized model actively prefers sovereign community vocabulary over colonial Spanish substitutions. 4. Accessible CPU deployment: Merging low-rank adapter weights and applying 8-bit CTranslate2 quantization reduced inference latency from 137.5 seconds down to 1.8–2.6 seconds per request. Widening the beam search to 8 resolved search-space truncations on short lexical inputs, enabling responsive and cost-bounded deployment on serverless CPU infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 除了总的计量收益外,我的实验活化和失败分析为本土和多合成NMT提供了具体的建筑外销: 1. LoRA中的子词嵌入限制:引入了新的特殊符号,同时冻结了共享嵌入矩阵,造成了一个未经过训练的瓶颈,会阻碍模型的趋同. 使用纯文本合成前缀对翻译编码器进行条件化再利用被预先训练的子字空间,并完全恢复模型性能. 2. 形态合成条件的密度: Sparse功能语法标记仅仅起到浅域指标的作用,而由基于规则的有限态分析器产生的高覆盖标记(95.8%)则提供明确的结构指导来改进复杂多合成目标的翻译(+1.33 chrF++). 3. 非殖民和多面评价: 单靠字符重叠衡量标准无法检测翻译是否尊重地方自治。 结合诊断形态学探针,长度常态化的"国内比亚斯分数"(DBS),以及盲目的人类分数,证实专业模式积极偏好主权共同体词汇而非殖民地西班牙替代. 4. 可用的CPU部署: 合并低等适配器重量并应用8位 CTranslate2 等分法,将推论纬度从137.5秒降低到每个请求1.8至2.6秒. 将光束搜索范围扩大至8个已解决的搜索空间短路,用于短词输入,从而能够在无服务器的CPU基础设施上进行响应性和成本限制的部署。

blocks.en: 9.1 Future Work
blocks.zh: 9.1 今后的工作

blocks.en: Moving forward, we plan to expand community-led evaluations with native speakers in Santa Ana Tlacotenco to establish formal qualitative rubrics for honorific and directional morphology. In addition, we will extend our finite-state conditioning pipeline to handle long-form discourse in community oral histories, and investigate parameter-efficient specialization across other Nawatl varieties using isolated, modular adapter banks.
blocks.zh: 展望未来,我们计划在圣安娜特拉科滕科扩大由社区牵头的土著演讲者进行的评价,以便为荣誉和定向形态学确定正式的定性主题。 此外,我们将扩大有限状态调节管道,以处理社区口述历史中的长式论述,并利用孤立的模块化适应器库,调查其他纳瓦特尔品种的参数效率专业化。

blocks.en: Ultimately, language technologies for minoritized languages should not aim to homogenize distinct varieties into a single generic system. By demonstrating that an existing sequence-to-sequence model can be rapidly and accurately aligned to a single community standard, this work provides a practical, decolonial blueprint for building translation tools that honor the linguistic sovereignty of indigenous speaker communities.
blocks.zh: 归根结底,次要语言的语言技术不应旨在将不同品种统一为一个单一的通用系统。 这项工作表明,现有的顺序与顺序模式能够迅速和准确地与单一的社区标准保持一致,为建设尊重讲土著语社区语言主权的翻译工具提供了一个实用、非殖民蓝图。
